cases.refreshed: Need help with 3D printing or looking for guided, hands-on experience? This session is ideal for beginners seeking practical experience, guided support, and confidence in using 3D printing technology. This is also a good opportunity for those who attended our 3D Design & Printing workshop and are ready for hands-on practice. Participants will have the opportunity to print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or a similar site. All designs are printed in one PLA filament color chosen by the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour and 45 minutes. If you're unsure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org. All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer. Final approval of printability will be determined by the program lead. SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request. One appointment per month per person.
cases.reviewed: Need help with 3D printing or want hands-on practice? This guided session helps beginners build confidence using a 3D printer. It's also a chance to practice if you've taken the library's 3D Design & Printing workshop. You can print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or a similar site. All designs are printed in one PLA filament color chosen by the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour and 45 minutes. If you're unsure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org. All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer. The program lead decides whether a design can be printed. SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request. Each person is limited to one appointment per month.
